name: Ashby Village, volunteer services
what_it_offers: rides, a companion at medical visits, small repairs, help with computers and phones, light gardening, companions, pet care, reading aloud, phone friends, food prep and grocery shopping
cost_to_user: membership fee (amounts shown only as images, not read)
limits: No bathing, feeding, home care or caregiver respite. A volunteer companion is for a one-time need. Garden work up to 1 hour, repair jobs up to 3 hours.
area: Albany, Berkeley, El Cerrito, Emeryville, Kensington, Richmond, Oakland (not Alameda)
their_words: cannot perform Activities of Daily Living (ADL) such as feeding, bathing, home care
notes: Replies on the Berkeley Parents Network forum point families here more than anywhere else (5 of 15 recent questions).

name: Ashby Village, professional service provider network
what_it_offers: members call the office to be referred to screened, paid providers
cost_to_user: the provider's own rates; no cost to be listed
limits: Application must be referred by a current member. Asks for services, rates, insurance, California licenses and certifications, time in business, three references, bonded or not, experience with elders, and any member discount. Licenses and references are checked. 17 categories, none for home care, caregivers, personal assistants, errands or bill paying; the closest are Computer Services and Organizing/Decorating.
their_words: no cost to be on the list of professional Service Providers
notes: Not found: who members are sent to for home care, and whether an independent aide can be listed.

name: Alameda County Directory for Older Adults (2021 edition)
what_it_offers: under money help: one paid fiduciary firm in Fremont; free case management and free legal help. Has a section called Caregivers/Companions For Hire.
limits: No technology or computer help programs listed. No daily money manager or paperwork helper listed.
notes: A 2021 edition, so some entries may be out of date.
